info.title: Lorebound API
info.description:
The Lorebound API behind the frontend: campaign settings, their lore entries and
relationships, sharing by invite, and characters built step by step.

## Authentication: a cookie, no tokens
1. `POST /api/auth/login` with `{ "email", "password" }` sets the httpOnly
   `lorebound.auth` cookie (Secure, SameSite=Lax, 14 days, sliding).
2. Send it with every later request (`credentials: "include"` in `fetch`). The API
   never returns bearer or refresh tokens.
3. `POST /api/auth/logout` clears it.

Every endpoint requires the cookie unless it is marked as not needing it here;
without it the response is **401** problem+json.

## CSRF: the `X-Requested-With` header
Every **POST, PUT, PATCH and DELETE** must send `X-Requested-With: Lorebound`,
and, if it carries an `Origin`, come from an allowed frontend origin. Otherwise the
response is **403** before the endpoint runs. GET needs neither.

## Errors
Every error is RFC 7807 `application/problem+json` with a `traceId`; quote it when
reporting a problem, it finds the request in the server logs. Invalid input is
**400** with an `errors` object keyed by field.

## Visibility
A setting you do not belong to is **404**, exactly like a missing one. Players never
see GM-only entries, nor relationships that touch them.

post.summary: Creates an account. Does not sign the user in and returns no token.

403.description: Forbidden, including a missing X-Requested-With header or a disallowed Origin.

post.summary:
Signs in and sets the httpOnly auth cookie. The body is only the user
summary; wrong password, unknown email and unconfirmed email all get the
same 401 so the response does not reveal which accounts exist.

403.description: Forbidden, including a missing X-Requested-With header or a disallowed Origin.

post.summary:
Signs out everywhere: changes the security stamp, so every copy of the
user's cookie stops working, and expires this browser's cookie (same
name and path as at sign-in).

403.description: Forbidden, including a missing X-Requested-With header or a disallowed Origin.

post.summary:
Confirms an email with the userId and code from the emailed link. An
unknown user, a malformed or wrong code, and an already-confirmed account
all get the same 400, so a code cannot be reused.

403.description: Forbidden, including a missing X-Requested-With header or a disallowed Origin.

post.summary:
Sends a fresh confirmation link. Always 204, whether the email is
unknown, already confirmed or sent to, so it reveals nothing.

403.description: Forbidden, including a missing X-Requested-With header or a disallowed Origin.

post.summary:
Emails a password reset link. Always 204; the link goes only to an
existing account whose email is confirmed, since that proves the inbox
belongs to the account.

403.description: Forbidden, including a missing X-Requested-With header or a disallowed Origin.

post.summary:
Sets a new password with the email and code from the reset link. Identity
changes the security stamp, which ends the user's other sessions and
makes the code single-use.

403.description: Forbidden, including a missing X-Requested-With header or a disallowed Origin.

get.summary:
The builder steps in order, with what each one stores: an entry type
from the setting or free text, whether it is required, and how many
answers it allows.

The options for one step, narrowed by the entries chosen in earlier
steps (ADR 0002). Free-text and display-only steps have none. An
unknown step is 404.

put.summary:
Replaces one step's answer in a single save and returns the updated
character. Entries must be of the step's type, in the character's
setting and visible to the caller, unless already chosen for this step;
a missing, other-setting or hidden entry gets the same 400. Sending no
entries and no text clears the step. Moves `currentStep` past the
step if it was behind. A complete character must be reopened first
(409).

post.summary:
Marks the character Complete once every required step has a valid
answer, every chosen entry still exists in the setting with the step's
type, no step is stale (P7-04) and the name is not blank. Otherwise 400
with one error per failing step, keyed by step key. Completing a
complete character again is a no-op.

Moves the character back to Draft so its answers can change again.
Reopening a draft is a no-op.

get.summary:
The caller's own characters, most recently updated first. Filters:
status, settingId, and
search (name contains, ignoring case). Characters in
a setting the caller has left are included, flagged read-only.

post.summary:
Starts a draft character owned by the caller, on step 1. Any member of
the setting may create one, GameMasters included (NPCs or their own
PC); a non-member or missing setting gets 404.

403.description: Forbidden, including a missing X-Requested-With header or a disallowed Origin.

get.summary:
One character with its choices. The owner (even read-only) and the
setting's GameMasters may read it; anyone else gets 404.

put.summary:
Replaces the name and backstory. Only the owner while still a member
of the setting; a removed owner or a GameMaster gets 403. The backstory
is free text, never rendered as HTML by the API.

delete.summary:
Deletes the character and, through the database cascade, its choices.
Only the owner, also after removal from the setting (a read-only
character can still be deleted); a GameMaster gets 403.

get.summary:
Counts, the 5 most recently updated settings the caller belongs to and
characters they own, and the 10 most recent changes across those
settings, their visible entries and the caller's characters. Players
never see activity on GM-only entries.

Whether the API is up and can reach its database. Public, for load
balancers and uptime checks: 200 with `database: "connected"`,
or 503 with `database: "unreachable"`.
What the user would join. Reading a preview never uses up the invite.

post.summary:
Joins the setting as a Player and uses up one use of the invite. A user
who already belongs gets 200 with their current role and uses nothing,
so retrying (a double click, a reload) is safe. Membership is checked
before validity, so the retry of an accept that took the last use is
still 200; a member learns nothing new from it. Everyone else gets the
identical 404 for an unusable code.

403.description: Forbidden, including a missing X-Requested-With header or a disallowed Origin.

get.summary:
The suggested relationship types, in display order. Any other label
is allowed too; these keep wording consistent.

Every character in the setting, removed players' included, most
recently updated first. GameMasters only (Player 403, non-member 404).
Filters: status, and search
(character or owner name contains, ignoring case).

Entries of the setting by name, filtered by type,
search (name or description, case-insensitive) and
gmOnly. For a Player, `gmOnly=true` matches
nothing, since they never see GM-only entries.

post.summary:
Adds an entry. GameMasters only. The name is trimmed and must be unique
per type within the setting, ignoring case (409 otherwise).

get.summary:
One entry with its outgoing and incoming relationships, each sorted by
the other entry's name. A Player asking for a GM-only entry gets the
same 404 as for a missing one, and relationships to GM-only entries are
left out, so a Player cannot learn a hidden entry exists.

put.summary:
Replaces an entry's name, type, description and secrecy. GameMasters
only; same rules as create, and the name check ignores the entry
itself. Making an entry GM-only does not change characters that already
chose it (decision recorded in P6-05).

delete.summary:
Deletes an entry. GameMasters only. An entry that still has
relationships (either direction) or that characters have chosen is 409
with `relationshipCount` and `characterCount` and nothing
changes, unless force is true: then its
relationships and the entry go together in one transaction, and the
characters keep their choices without the entry (P6-09).

post.summary:
Creates a Player invite. The body is optional; expiry defaults to
7 days and uses to unlimited.

get.summary: Every invite of the setting, newest first, with its current status.

delete.summary:
Revokes an invite so it can no longer be accepted. The row is kept;
revoking twice is a no-op 204.

get.summary: Owner first, then GameMasters, then Players, each oldest first.

patch.summary:
Promotes or demotes a member. Owner only. Setting the role a member
already has is a no-op 200; the owner is always a GameMaster.

delete.summary:
Removes a member, or lets a member leave (their own userId). Any member
but the owner may leave; GameMasters remove Players; only the owner
removes a GameMaster; nobody removes the owner. Takes effect at once:
the next request from the removed user gets 404 on the setting. Their
characters are kept, read-only (P6-10, see ICharacterAccess).

get.summary:
The setting's relationships, sorted by source name, type and target
name. entryId keeps the links of one entry in either
direction (404 if the caller cannot see that entry);
type keeps one relationship type, ignoring case.

post.summary:
Links two entries. GameMasters only. Both entries must belong to the
setting in the route (400 otherwise, the same for a missing entry); a
self-link is 400 and an existing (source, target, type) link is 409.

put.summary:
Replaces a relationship's type and description. GameMasters only. The
endpoints are immutable: a `sourceEntryId` or `targetEntryId`
that differs from the current one is 400 (delete and recreate to
re-link). Changing to a type the same link already has is 409.

delete.summary: Deletes a relationship. GameMasters only; the entries stay.

post.summary:
Creates a setting owned by the caller, who becomes its GameMaster. The
name is trimmed and must be unique among the caller's own settings,
ignoring case (409 otherwise).

403.description: Forbidden, including a missing X-Requested-With header or a disallowed Origin.

get.summary:
The settings the caller owns or belongs to, most recently updated
first. search matches the name (contains, ignoring
case); role is `gm` or `player` (400
otherwise). Players' entry counts leave out GM-only entries.

One setting with the caller's role, the member count and entry counts
by type (GM-only entries left out for Players). Any member may read
it; anyone else gets 404.

put.summary:
Renames the setting and replaces its description. GameMasters only
(Players get 403); the name must stay unique among the owner's
settings (409).

delete.summary:
Deletes the setting with its entries, relationships, memberships,
invites and characters. The owner only; other members get 403.

put.summary:
Changes the display name (1-60 characters, trimmed). Email and password
changes are out of scope for now.

403.description: Forbidden, including a missing X-Requested-With header or a disallowed Origin.

delete.summary:
Deletes the account after re-checking the password (400 keyed
`Password` when wrong; rate limited like login). Blocked with 409
and the list of settings while the user owns a setting that has other
members: there is no ownership transfer, so they must delete the
setting or remove its members first. Otherwise, in one transaction:
the settings they own (with everything in them), their memberships,
characters and invites elsewhere, then the user. Signs out; 204.

AcceptInviteResponse.description: The setting the user now belongs to, and their role in it.

AuthUserDto.description: The signed-in user's summary. Never carries a token.

BuilderStepDto.description:
One builder step. SettingEntryType? BuilderStepDto.EntryType is the entry type offered as
options (null for free-text and display-only steps);
int? BuilderStepDto.MaxFreeTextLength is set only when
bool BuilderStepDto.AllowFreeText; int BuilderStepDto.MaxSelections is 0 for steps
that store nothing (setting, review).

BuilderStepsDto.description: The builder step catalog (P7-01), ordered by int BuilderStepDto.Order.

CharacterChoiceDto.description:
One builder answer; choices are sorted by step key then ordinal. A chosen
entry keeps its name even if it later became GM-only; a deleted entry
leaves Guid? CharacterChoiceDto.EntryId, string? CharacterChoiceDto.EntryName and
SettingEntryType? CharacterChoiceDto.EntryType null.

CharacterDetailDto.description:
One character with its builder choices (P6-05), returned by create and
read. bool CharacterDetailDto.IsOwner says whether the caller owns it (only the
owner may delete); bool CharacterDetailDto.IsReadOnly says whether the caller may
not edit it (false only for an owner who still belongs to the setting).
IReadOnlyList<string> CharacterDetailDto.StaleSteps lists, in step order, the keys of steps whose
chosen entry is no longer among that step's narrowed options after an
earlier step changed (P7-04); the choice is kept, never deleted.

CharacterListItemDto.description:
One of the caller's own characters on the Characters page and dashboard
(P6-04). string? CharacterListItemDto.HomelandName comes from the first
`homeland` choice (its entry's name, or its free text), null when
there is none. bool CharacterListItemDto.IsReadOnly is true once the caller is no
longer a member of the setting.

ConfirmEmailRequest.description: The userId and code from the emailed confirmation link.

CreateCharacterRequest.description:
Starts a draft character in a setting the caller belongs to (P6-03). A
missing or blank string? CreateCharacterRequest.Name becomes "Unnamed Character".

CreateInviteRequest.description: Both optional: expiry defaults to 7 days, uses to unlimited.

CreateRelationshipRequest.description:
Links two entries of the setting in the route (P5-03). The setting is
always taken from the route, never from the body.

DashboardActivityDto.description:
One recent change, derived from `UpdatedAt` (there is no activity
log), so it says what changed, not who changed it. Guid DashboardActivityDto.Id is the
setting, entry or character; Guid DashboardActivityDto.SettingId is the setting it
belongs to, for building links.

DashboardCountsDto.description:
Settings the caller owns or is a GameMaster of, settings where the caller
is a Player, and the caller's own characters by status.

DashboardDto.description:
Everything the dashboard page shows, in one response (P8-01).
IReadOnlyList<SettingListItemDto> DashboardDto.RecentSettings and IReadOnlyList<CharacterListItemDto> DashboardDto.RecentCharacters are the
same items the Settings and Characters lists return.

DeleteAccountRequest.description: Deleting the account needs the current password again (P6-11).

EntryDetailDto.description:
One entry with its relationships (P4-04). Relationships whose other entry
the caller cannot see are left out. bool? EntryDetailDto.IsGmOnly is only sent
to GameMasters.

EntryListItemDto.description:
One row of the entries list (P4-02). bool? EntryListItemDto.IsGmOnly is only sent
to GameMasters. int EntryListItemDto.RelationshipCount counts links in both
directions whose other entry the caller can see.

EntryRelationshipDto.description:
A relationship seen from one entry: the entry at the other end (the
target for outgoing, the source for incoming) and how they relate.

InvitePreviewDto.description: What a signed-in user sees before accepting an invite.

InviteStatus.description: Where an invite stands at a given moment. Not stored; computed.

LoginRequest.description:
RememberMe = false gives a session cookie; true gives the 14-day
persistent cookie.

MemberDto.description: One member of a setting. Never carries an email.

PagedResultOfCharacterListItemDto.description: Envelope returned by every list endpoint.

PagedResultOfEntryListItemDto.description: Envelope returned by every list endpoint.

PagedResultOfInviteDto.description: Envelope returned by every list endpoint.

PagedResultOfMemberDto.description: Envelope returned by every list endpoint.

PagedResultOfRelationshipDto.description: Envelope returned by every list endpoint.

PagedResultOfSettingCharacterListItemDto.description: Envelope returned by every list endpoint.

PagedResultOfSettingListItemDto.description: Envelope returned by every list endpoint.

RegisterRequest.description:
The password policy (length 10+) is enforced by Identity, not attributes,
so its errors come back under "Password" like any other validation error.

RelationshipDto.description: A link from RelationshipEndpointDto RelationshipDto.Source to RelationshipEndpointDto RelationshipDto.Target (P5-02, P5-03).

RelationshipEndpointDto.description: The entry at one end of a relationship.

RelationshipTypesDto.description:
Relationship types to offer when linking entries (P5-05). Any other
text is accepted too.

ResetPasswordRequest.description:
Email and code come from the emailed reset link. Identity enforces the
password policy on NewPassword.

SaveChoiceRequest.description:
One step's answer (P7-03): entries for an entry step, free text for a
free-text step. Sending neither clears the step.

SettingCharacterListItemDto.description:
One character of a setting in the GameMaster view (P6-08).
bool SettingCharacterListItemDto.OwnerIsMember is false for characters of players who were
removed from the setting; they stay listed. string? SettingCharacterListItemDto.HomelandName
is as in CharacterListItemDto.

SettingEntryDto.description:
One entry, returned by create and update (P4-03, P4-05).
bool? SettingEntryDto.IsGmOnly is only sent to GameMasters.

SettingRole.description: A user's role in one setting. Stored as its name, so reordering is safe.

StepOptionsDto.description:
The options for one builder step (P7-02). bool StepOptionsDto.Narrowed is true
when earlier choices limited them to linked entries.

UpdateEntryRequest.description: Replaces every field; same rules as CreateEntryRequest.

UpdateProfileRequest.description: Email and password changes are out of scope for now.

UpdateRelationshipRequest.description:
Replaces a relationship's type and description (P5-04). The endpoints
cannot change: Guid? UpdateRelationshipRequest.SourceEntryId and Guid? UpdateRelationshipRequest.TargetEntryId
are accepted only so that a different value can be rejected with 400
instead of being silently ignored. Delete and recreate to re-link.

cookieAuth.description: Set by POST /api/auth/login; httpOnly, so browsers send it automatically.
